This weekend, Sportsmail will provide information for every Premier League game, including team news, possible lineups, betting odds, and statistics from Opta. Here is the information for Sunderland’s home game against Newcastle.

Sunderland vs Newcastle United (Stadium of Light)

Team News: Sunderland midfielder Lee Cattermole will return to the starting lineup for Sunday’s derby match against Newcastle. Head coach Dick Advocaat confirmed that Cattermole will be back against Newcastle after serving a two-match ban for reaching 10 bookings for the season.

If Rory McIlroy wins the upcoming Masters, he will become the world’s best golfer and complete a career grand slam. This is the final step in his lifelong journey. With help from his sponsor, Bose, McIlroy made a video showing his life from playing on small greens as a child to becoming a top golfer, including some difficult times. The video starts with McIlroy going for a run early in the morning, while the words “Six weeks to Georgia” appear on the screen. The video also includes an interview with McIlroy when he was young, before he became famous.

Sergio Garcia says he is only thinking about winning his first PGA Tour event since 2022 at this week’s Shell Houston Open. The Masters golf tournament is coming up soon.

For weeks, the big news has been about Rory McIlroy trying to win three majors in a row to complete his career grand slam, and about whether Tiger Woods will return to the game after staying away for a while. But, even though the Golf Club of Houston is trying to make the course feel like the one at Augusta, Garcia is only focused on ending his long wait for a win.

Riki Hughes, a 31-year-old Iraq war veteran, has been sentenced to 16 months in prison. He was the club secretary for Tidworth Town Football Club, where he volunteered. He stole £17,000 from the club. He told people he was paying rent for the club’s building, even though the team was using the property for free. Instead, he used the money for himself. This includes buying camping gear and paying for a bachelor party trip to Las Vegas.

Johnny Sexton is used to winning. He has won many awards, and he wants to keep winning. He was getting ready for a big game against Saracens in Paris. He talked about how lucky he has been. He played for Leinster and Ireland, and almost every year he won a trophy. The 29-year-old has only had one year, 2010, when he did not win a major award.

Mustafa Kamal stepped down as president of the International Cricket Council (ICC) on Wednesday. He was a Bangladeshi. He said India influenced the result of the Cricket World Cup quarter-final match between Bangladesh and India. India uses its power in the ICC to change the game’s outcome. He said this at the airport when he returned from the tournament in Australia. He said everyone saw what happened during the Bangladesh-India match. He said he would acted the same way if it happened to any other country. A picture shows Mustafa Kamal with the Cricket World Cup trophy. He has stepped down as ICC President.

West Ham manager Sam Allardyce supports Nigel Pearson, the manager of Leicester City. Allardyce respects Pearson for being independent and doing things his own way. Allardyce worked with Pearson at Newcastle United in 207. They will meet again this Saturday when West Ham plays Leicester at the King Power Stadium. Pearson has been in trouble several times this season. He grabbed Crystal Palace player James McArthur by the throat and lost his temper with a reporter during a press conference.

Sunderland’s manager, John O'Shea, wants his team to take control of their own destiny by beating Newcastle for the fifth game in a row. The two teams play at the Stadium of Light on Sunday. Sunderland has won the last four games against Newcastle, but they really need these three points to stay away from the fight to avoid being promoted to the Premier League. O'Shea and his players could find themselves in the relegation zone by the time they run out if Burnley get the better of Tottenham in the day's earlier kick-off, and that would make three points a necessity.

Stoke City manager Mark Hughes believes his team needs to stop losing to Chelsea at their home stadium, Stamford Bridge. Since Stoke was promoted to the Premier League in 208, they have played Chelsea away eight times and lost every match. The last time Stoke won at Chelsea’s ground was in 1995, when they won the League Cup. The last time Stoke got any points (a win or a tie) at Chelsea’s stadium was a 1-1 tie in 1984. Mark Hughes, the manager of Stoke City, says his team must end their losing streak at Chelsea. Frank Lampard (right) celebrates as Chelsea beat Stoke 3-0 on their most recent visit to Stamford Bridge.

Newcastle United wants to avoid losing their third game in a row when they play their rivals, Sunderland, this Sunday. They have been struggling recently without banned striker Papiss Cisse. Dick Advocaat’s team is at last place in the Barclays Premier League, just one point above the bottom three. But Sportsmail can reveal that John Carver’s team would be two points adrift of their foes in the relegation zone if it weren’t for Cisse’s goals. The Senegal forward is Newcastle’s top scorer this season with 11 goals, with 10 of those decisive in changing games in the Magpies’ favour.

Dick Advocaat, the manager of Sunderland, is happy to have Lee Cattermole back as a central midfielder. Cattermole is 27 years old and known for his tough play. He missed the last two games because he was suspended. He had received 10 yellow cards for the season. This also means he not available for Advocaat's first game as manager, which was a 1-0 loss to West Ham on March 21. However, Cattermole was the only player told he will definitely start against Newcastle on Sunday during Friday's team meeting. Advocaat is looking for a big response from a player who has once again missed a significant part of the season through injury.

Ronny Deila, the manager of Celtic, knows that winning the Champions League isn’t just about money. But there is a very good reason to win the league for the fourth time in a row: £16 million. This money comes from UEFA, the group that runs the Champions League. UEFA has said how much money teams will get for the next three years. The last time Celtic played in the Champions League group stage (2103-2014), they played against AC Milan, Ajax, and Barcelona. They won one game and got £12.6 million. If they do the same or better next season, they will get £4 million more. If they get to the last 16 teams, they will get more than £20 million.

Tottenham defender Ben Davies is focused on the game and, despite playing against his Wales teammate Sam Vokes, he won’t let emotions get in the way. The match is at Burnley’s stadium, Turf Moor, on Sunday. Tottenham, who have only lost once in their last four Premier League games (a loss to Manchester United), are hoping to stay in the European competition race. Burnley, who are in 18 place, are fighting to avoid being relegated, and are only one point away from safety. Earlier this season, Sam Vokes scored for Burnley against Tottenham in the FA Cup, and Ben Davies looked upset after Burnley tied the game in the third round at Turf Moor.

Neil Redfearn, the manager of Leeds United, is thinking about whether he should keep his job. This is because the club suspended his assistant, Steve Thompson, on Thursday.

Leeds took two months to hire Thompson, but he was told in a letter from director of football Nicola Salerno yesterday morning that he is suspended until the end of the season. This effectively ends his time at the club after only 105 days. Thompson has been told that he will be suspended until his contract ends at the end of the season. He has also been told that the club will not use an option to renew his deal. Leeds United assistant manager Steve Thompson (left) has been suspended by the club.

John Carver says he will push his Newcastle players hard if he has to, so they are ready for Sunday’s game against Sunderland at the Stadium of Light. Newcastle has lost the last four games to Sunderland. Carver, who was Alan Pardew’s assistant during those losses, admits that Sunderland wanted the win more than Newcastle did. “In the last four games Sunderland worked harder than us - and that's not a good stat to have,” he said. John Carver says he will 'whip' his players to make sure they're motivated to beat Sunderland on Sunday

David Templeton, a player for Rangers, has strongly criticized the training methods used by former managers Ally McCoist and Kenny McDowall. He says that Stuart McCall, the new manager, has brought a new style of coaching and tactics that was missing before. Templeton is happy with how McCall has done since he started last month on a short-term contract. The team has won two games in a row, which has made everyone feel more confident before their home game against Hearts this Saturday. Templeton thinks McCall has done a great job.

Celta Vigo player Nolito says Lionel Messi should stay home instead of playing against his team on Sunday. Nolito thinks Messi might hurt his foot again. Messi has been practicing and is expected to be ready to play, but Nolito wants him to rest. Nolito told a reporter that Messi could enjoy the beach instead of playing. and joked that he would call Messi’s father. Messi is expected to be healthy for the game against Celta Vigo.

Hearts manager Robbie Neilson says that players like captain Danny Wilson will only leave the club if he believes it is the best decision for the team. Wilson has been named by Celtic as a potential signing for the summer, according to Sportsmail. Neilson admitted that it is expected that other clubs would show interest in his promoted players. The manager will not sell any players unless it is the right move for the club. The coach agrees with owner Ann Budge that departures will only happen if he says it is okay and if the price is right.

Sam Allardyce, the manager of West Ham, has warned Liverpool’s Brendan Rodgers that giving Raheem Sterling a new, very high-paid contract could cause problems for the rest of the team. Allardyce believes that if Sterling gets more than the £100,000 per week he was already offered, his teammates will ask for more money too. However, Allardyce does not blame Sterling, who currently earns £35,000 a week, for trying to get as much money as possible. Allardyce feels that because there are so few talented young players, clubs are willing to pay huge amounts of money to sign any young player they can find. Liverpool and England star Raheem Sterling has stalled over signing a new contract at the Anfield club

Blackpool Football Club is talking to Thomas Piermayr about signing him. Piermayr is a 25 defender from Austria. He has been training with Blackpool this week. Blackpool wants to sign him because they expect to play in League One next season. Piermayr is not currently playing for any team (free agent). He last played for the Colorado Rapids. He used to play for Inverness Caledonian Thistle in 211. He never played in England but Blackpool could give him his first chance.

Tony Pulis plans to talk with West Bromwich Albion chairman Jeremy Peace about making the team a top-ten club again, once the team has secured its place in the Premier League. Pulis said that West Brom has "lost its way" in recent years and needs major changes to get back on track. The team finished 10th and 8th under Roy Hodgson and Steve Clarke, but last season they had a chaotic campaign and finished 17th, barely avoiding relegation. West Bromwich Albion manager Tony Pulis (left) shouts instructions from the sideline against Man City.

Arsenal legend Ian Wright is upset that Theo Walcott is leaving North London. Wright thinks Walcott’s struggles at the club are because Arsene Wenger refused to play him as a striker. Walcott has only started five games for Arsenal this season. He has been out for seven months with a serious knee injury. With Arsenal trying to sign Raheem Sterling and Walcott’s contract ending next summer, Wright is worried that the team might lose a valuable player.

Roberto Martinez, the manager of Everton, believes Ross Barkley will become a more important player for both his club and country. now that he has recovered from a difficult second season. Barkley’s recent time with Everton has been average, partly because he was selected for England’s World Cup team last summer and had knee surgery that delayed his return to regular play. However, England’s coach, Roy Hodgson, still trusts the 21-year-old. Martinez thinks Barkley’s two recent appearances as a substitute for England against Lithuania and Italy prove that the midfielder is ready to improve his game again.

England’s Under-19 soccer team will not play in the European Championships this summer. They lost 2-1 to France in their final qualifying match. Before this game, England had already won against Denmark and Azerbaijan. They needed to beat France in Saint-Lo to qualify for the finals in Greece in July. However, goals by Sehrou Guirassy and Gnaly Cornet gave France the the lead. England’s Patrick Roberts scored a late goal, but it was not enough for Sean O’Driscoll’s team to qualify.

Jonas Gutierrez, a 31-year-old midfielder for Newcastle, wants to help his team beat their rivals, Sunderland, in an upcoming match. This would be a big win for Newcastle, who have been struggling. Gutierrez recently returned to playing after recovering from testicular cancer. He has played as a substitute in the last three games, and everyone has been very welcoming to his return. However, Newcastle lost all three of those games. Now, they are trying to recover from four losses in a straight. They will play Sunderland on Sunday at Sunderland's stadium, hoping to end their losing streak.

During a close rugby league match on Good Friday at ANZ Stadium in Sydney, South Sydney (the Rabbitohs) beat Canterbury (the Bulldogs) 18-17 with a last-minute try. The game ended controversially because fans threw objects at the referees.

 After the Bulldogs' captain, James Graham, was penalated in the final minute, the Rabbitohs won the game. Angry fans blamed referee Gerard Sutton and his team for the result. As the referees, officials, and players were leaving the field toward the tunnel, some spectators threw plastic water bottles and shouted insults at them.

Kevin Sinfield, the former captain of the England rugby team, has been told that he will be a "target" when he switches to rugby union at the end of the season. Sinfield, 34, who is the greatest captain in Leeds' history, shocked the rugby league world on Tuesday with his sudden announcement that he will leave the sport at the end of the season and join the Rhinos' sister club Yorkshire Carnegie on an 18-month contract. Leeds Rhinos captain Kevin Sinfield is to switch codes and join Yorkshire Carnegie at the end of the season.

Raheem Sterling said he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool. even though the club offered him £100,000 a week to stay. The 20-year-old is now closer to leaving Anfield. He told the BBC on Wednesday that he would have accepted much less money a year ago. However. even though he is one of Liverpool’s best players. Sterling has not played as well as he did last season. The program, called Protect, Inform and Prevent (PIP), helps players understand what counts as legal consent. The training includes private question and answer sessions where players can talk about past experiences. It is led by a former police detective and a psychotherer.

A new video made by Leo Burnett Toronto for the charity Humans For Humans shows homeless people reading cruel tweets written about them. It is very sad to watch. The video wants people to think more kindly about those who sleep outside. Many of the people cry as they read mean comments, like "I hate the homeless" and "I almost vomed when I saw a homeless girl."

George Boyd is the most active player in the Barclays Premier League this season. He has run a total of 210.5 miles on the field. This distance is the same as running from Burnley’s Turf Moor stadium to Crystal Palace’s Selhurst Park in south London. The Burnley winger has run slightly further than Tottenham Hotspur midfielder Christian Eriksen. The journey from Turf Moor to Selhurst would usually take 69 hours, according to Google Maps' estimations, but Boyd has managed it in less than 40 hours of playing time.

Police in Birmingham have arrested the parents of a five-month baby girl who died. The father, 25, and the mother, 25, who live in Perry Barr, were taken into custody after their daughter passed away yesterday afternoon.

 Police arrived at their home just before 1am yesterday morning because the baby was having trouble breathing. The baby was taken to Birmingham Children's Hospital but died a few hours later. A police spokesperson said the death is suspicious and an autopsy will be done today to find out the exact cause of death.

Gordon Taylor, the head of the players' union, says Raheem Sterling is not being disloyal to Liverpool by pausing talks about a new contract until the summer. The 20-year-old English player has received what manager Brendan Rodgers called "an incredible offer," believed to be £100,000 a week, but negotiations have ended in a stalemate. Sterling has insisted he is not a "money graber" and Taylor, chief executive of the Professional Footballers' Association, believes waiting until the season is over before resuming talks could be a wise move. Raheem Sterling admitted in a TV interview that he is not ready to sign a new contract at Liverpool.

It has been a difficult time for former Manchester United player Anderson since he returned to Brazil. On Wednesday, his own mistake was made look even worse by a teammate’s foolish action. Anderson was sent off during Internacional’s 1-1 draw in Porto Alegre. He received a red card for shoping an opposing player, Otacilio Neto, off the ball. Neto was also sent off for elbowing Anderson in return. However, Anderson’s teammate Fabricio drew more attention by swearing at his own fans. Fabricio was the third player to be sent off, leaving Internacional with only nine players on the field.

A seven-year-old boy was attacked by two young men while he was out buying food. in Bhiwandi, a suburb of Mumbai. The attackers took the boy to a remote location and raped him. When he fought back, they set him on fire, according to Inspector Sasthe. The boy suffered burns over 30 percent of his body but he somehow escaped. The police are investigating the crime. The incident took place in Padma Nagar, Bhiwandi.

Dug, a pug, has recovered after being bitten in the face by a rattlesnake. Dug and his owner, Lindsay Castro, were hiking on the Jurupa Hills trail in Fontana, Canada, on Thursday. They heard a ratting sound. Lindsay moved back, but Dug ran toward the snake. The snake bit Dug in the face, and his face swelled to twice its size. Scroll down for video. Horific: Dug the pug's face swelled to twice its size after he was bitten in the face by a rattlesnake. Curious pup: He had been hiking with his owner when he ran toward a rattle sound - and suffered for it.

Alvaro Arbeloa, a defender for Real Madrid, says Jose Mourinho might return to manage the team in the future. Arbeloa is right about this, even though Mourinho left Real Madrid in a messy way. Mourinho managed Real Madrid for three years before going back to Chelsea in 23. There were rumors that he had fights with important players like Iker Casillas, Sergio Ramos, and Pepe. Arbeloa, who has played 25 games for the team this season, says that Real Madrid would still consider hiring Mourinho as their coach.

On Saturday, Liverpool’s hopes of reaching the Champions League ended at the Emirates Stadium. Manager Brendan Rodgers made this clear during his 15-minute press conference. He admitted that his team’s chances of qualifying were over. It was a sad moment for lost opportunities.

 Rodgers tried to stay positive. He never looks unhappy, but he did not pretend that this season has been easy. After a strong challenge for the title last year, Liverpool have fallen out of the race. It is a hard reality for a club that thought it was returning to success. It still feels like Liverpool are moving forward under Rodgers.

Inter Milan coach Roberto Mancini was angry because his team drew 1-1 at home against Parma, a team near the bottom of the league. He cancelled the players' day off on Easter Sunday and made them come in for an early morning training session.

Inter Milan confirmed on their website (www.inter.it) that the first team trained at 8:30 a.m. local time. Club vice-president Javier Zanetti and sporting director Piero Ausilio watched the training. Mancini was furious with his players' attitude. The Saturday's draw left Inter Milan tied for ninth place with Genoa, and 10 points behind the spots that qualify for European competitions.

Many fans want to buy rare items that used to belong to their favorite players or teams. These small pieces of history can sell for thousands of pounds. However, you might be surprised to learn that an expired passport of Paul Parker was listed on eBay for £5,000. Paul Parker is best known for playing as a right back for Manchester United and England in the 1990s. The item was listed in early March, and bidding ended on Tuesday. It is not clear if anyone actually paid the large amount of money.

People have seen images of Jesus on toast, pancakes, crisps, and even ice cream. But a builder named Paddy Morrall was surprised when he saw an image of Jesus on a piece of wood just before Easter. Paddy found the image of a full-length figure of Christ on a broken scaffolding board in Inverness, Scotland, on Wednesday. The video shows this. The image of Jesus, wearing a robe, appeared after Paddy and his coworkers left the wood outside in the rain for several hours. The 31-year-old builder, who lives near Bradford, has kept the board.

On Tuesday, Slovakia beat the Czech Republic 1-0 in a friendly soccer match. Ondrej Duda scored the only goal after halftime. The 20-year-old midfielder kicked a low shot from outside the penalty area in the 49th minute. This was his second goal for his country. Since Slovakia and the Czech Republic became separate countries in 1993, Slovakia has now won three out of ten games against the Czech Republic. The Czech Republic has won five games. During the match, Slovakia’s Martin Skrtel kicked Czech Republic’s Daniel Kolar in the face with his high boot. Slovakia’s team was happy to win, which continued their good recent play.

Karim Benzema, a star player for Real Madrid, showed that he can do more than just play football. He posted a video of himself rapping while driving his Bugatti Veyron. The video came out as Real Madrid prepare for their La Liga game against Granada at the Bernabeu on Sunday. Benzema sang along to Tupac's song "Check Out Time." Tupac's song "All Eyez on Me" might have been a better choice for Benzema, though, as Benzema looks to add to his goal tally of 20 goals in all competitions so far this season. Real Madrid and France forward Karim Benzema sings along to Tupac in his Bugatti Veyron.

Harvey Boulter, a wealthy businessman who supports UKIP, is trying to stop a popular Conservative candidate from winning. He is angry at Liam Fox, who was forced to quit his job as Defence Secretary because of him. Boulter has already given £30,000 to the UKIP candidate who is running against Fox in Somerset. He is also spending another £30,000 to try to beat Tom Tugendhat, who is running for the Conservatives in Tonbridge and West Malling, Kent.

The game between Sheffield Wednesday and Huddersfield ended in a 1-1 tie. Two goals were scored in the final four minutes. Sergiu Bus, a substitute for Sheffield Wednesday, scored first in the 86th minute. Ishmael Miller, also a substitute, scored a goal just before the end of the game to tie the score. This result means Huddersfield has not won any of their last seven games. They are currently 18th in the league table, six places and nine points behind Sheffield Wednesday. Sergiu Bus is shown celebrating after he scored to put Sheffield Wednesday ahead.

Stuart Dallas has come a long way since Mark Warburton signed him from a local park for £70 a week. The 23-year-old, who had played for Northern Ireland earlier in the week, scored two excellent goals as Brentford beat Fulham 4-1 on Good Friday. They are now looking at more than just a play-off spot for Monday's game against Nottingham Forest. It was three years ago when Dallas was spotted by Warburton playing part-time on a muddy field for Crusaders back home. Stuart Dallas celebrates the second of his two excellent goals against Fulham on good Friday. Dallas has been a revelation this season as he helps Brentford push towards the Premier League.

Baseball is America’s most popular hobby, so it’s no surprise that fans feel strongly about their favorite teams. The New York Yankees and Boston Red Sox are the biggest rivals, and they have the most and second-most fans, respectively. The Texas Rangers and Atlanta Braves also have many fans in the South. Some teams, like the New York Mets, have fewer fans. Scroll down for the video.

Trey Moses, a high school basketball star, made a girl with Down syndrome very happy. He asked her to go to prom with him.

Trey is a senior at Eastern High School in Louisville, Kentucky. He will play basketball for Ball State University next year. He volunteers with teenagers who have learning disabilities.

On Thursday, he surprised Ellie Meredith during her P.E. class. He gave her flowers and a sign. The sign said, "Let's Party Like it's 1989." This is a reference to a song by Taylor Swift, who is Ellie's favorite singer.

Ellie said yes. She told CNN that she can't wait to go dress shopping. because she has already told "a million people" about it.

On April Fools' Day, President Barack Obama took a break from his duties to pretend to be Frank Underwood, a character from the TV show *House of Cards*. Underwood is a scheming politician played by actor Kevin Spacey, who often talks directly to the audience in a Shakespeare-style way. "Hello everybody. This is not Frank Underwood," the president said, turning his head. "This is Barack Obama. Happy April Fools' Day. Frank learned it from me," he said, using a Southern accent.

Ludovic Obraniak, a midfielder for Caykur Rizespor, was taken to the hospital on Saturday after he was taken out of the game against Fenerbahce. The team said he might have a heart problem. He had to leave the match after only 30 minutes so he could get medical tests. The team said on social media that he was not in immediate danger after the first tests. Ludovic Obraniak is currently on loan at Caykur Rizespor from the German team Werder Bremen. Moussa Sow scored for Fenerbahce during their 5-1 win on Saturday.

On Easter Sunday night, a crash occurred on Warringah Road in Frenchs Forest, northern Sydney. A 1973 E-Type Jaguar, worth over $120,000, collided head with a Toyota Kluger at a traffic light intersection. The Jaguar was completely destroyed. No one was injured, but three adults were taken to the hospital as a precaution. NSW police are still investigating the details of the crash.

People in Shandong Province, China, have been carrying natural gas in plastic bags. Recent photos from Lijin village in Dongying city show people pushing rickshaws with bags of gas that can be up to six meters long. The People’s Daily Online reported this. Passers-by are worried because this is like carrying a bomb. They say that if the bags touch a flame or even a cigarette, it could cause a disaster. Gas-guzzler: Caring natural gas in huge plastic bags is a common scene in some villages in Shandong. Penny-pinching: Local media suggest this is a way for villages to save money on the transportation of gas.

Tiger Woods was seen practicing at Augusta National, which has made people hopeful that he will play in this year's first major golf tournament. Woods has not played on the PGA Tour since February 5, when he stopped playing at the Farmers Insurance Open because his back pain came back. He has taken time off to try to get better, but many people think he will come back for the Masters, a tournament he has won four times. Woods was seen practicing at Augusta on Tuesday and is said to have returned to the course. Woods has dropped out of the top 100 for the first time in almost 19 years.

The BBC is facing criticism for spending thousands of pounds of public money on a 44-page guide that teaches staff how to use emojis correctly. The guide was ordered by BBC executives, who hired an agency to research how smile icons could be used in news stories and on social media. The BBC spent public money on a 44-page guide on how to use emojis before using a 'sad face' emoticon to describe the death of the world's oldest woman.

Moses Kipsiro, a top distance runner and frequent training partner of Mo Farah, says he is afraid for his life. This is because he reported a coach to the authorities in Uganda for sexually abusing female runners, some of whom are as young as 15. Kipsiro, who successfully defended his Commonwealth Games 10,00m title in Glasgow last year, told Sportsmail this week about the day five female runners came to him for help. and the death threats he says he has subsequently received after reporting the allegations to his national federation and the police.

Patrick Kluivert, a former Dutch football player and assistant coach, has started his job as head coach of Curacao with a win. His team advanced to the next round of the 2018 World Cup qualifying matches in the CONCACAF region. late Tuesday. Curacao drew 2-2 in the second game against Montserrat, but they won the overall series 4-3. Kluivert’s team had already won 2-1 on Saturday in Willemstad. Kluivert helped Curacao to the next stage of the 2018 World Cup qualifying. The former Dutch assistant coach worked with Louis van Gaal at the 2014 World Cup.

Brady Eaves, an 18-year-old student, has been kicked out of his fraternity, removed from college, and sent for a mental health evaluation. He was caught on video biting the head off a live hamster. DailyMail.com revealed last weekend that Eaves, the stepson of a former candidate for governor in Mississippi, was the teenager laughing while killing the small animal. The video was taken at a drunken Spring Break party in Florida. The footage could lead to felony animal cruelty charges against Eaves, which carry a maximum jail term of five years and a $5,000 fine.

Sri Lanka’s sports minister, Navin Dissanayake, asked on Wednesday that Kumar Sangakkara should change his mind and stay in limited overs cricket for one more year. Sangakkara said on March 18 that he was done with one-day cricket. He was upset because Sri Lanka lost in the quarter-finals of the World Cup. He said he was happy because Sri Lanka is in a better place now than when he started playing in 2000. Dissanayake told reporters, "At this moment as the sports minister, I humly request Kumar Sangakkara to render his service to the country for another one year period."

Edinburgh Rugby has called back three Scottish players for their European Challenge Cup quarter-final match against London Irish this Sunday. Dougie Fife, Alasdair Dickinson, and Ross Ford were rested for the last week’s 26-15 Pro12 victory over the Scarlets in Llanelli. so they could recover after playing for Scotland in the Six Nations tournament. Head coach Alan Solomons has named his strongest team for the game at the Madejski Stadium. Fife is one of three Scottish players returning to Edinburgh after their international duty.

Chris Ramsey, the manager of QPR, says Tony Pulis is one of the best coaches in Britain. But Ramsey says he does not need to learn tactics from him. Ramsey’s QPR team plays against Pulis’s West Brom on Saturday at The Hawthorns. They are 19th in the Barclays Premier League. They are four points behind Sunderland, who are 17th. QPR has only earned four points since the year started. They might need a finish like Pulis had with Crystal Palace in 213-14. That team took 17 points in their last eight games and avoided being relegated. Chris Ramsey praised Tony Pulis before their important game in the Premier League.

Silhan Ozcelik, an 18-year-old student, appeared in court. She is accused of planning to travel abroad to fight for Kurdish rebels against the Islamic State. Ozcelik went missing from her Kurdish family’s home in north London last October when she was 17. The Old Bailey heard that she traveled on the Eurostar with another man to Stuttgart, Germany, where the Kurdish Workers’ Party (PKK) youth movement has its headquarters.
